name: Vaal Venom Gyre
description: Creates already-caught projectiles without firing them first, both immediately and over a secondary duration. Caught projectiles spiral outwards when you use Whirling Blades and do not return. Requires a Dagger or Claw.

stats: Creates up to 50 caught Projectiles immediately
60% of Physical Damage Converted to Chaos Damage
40% chance to keep each caught Projectile fired with Whirling Blades
Modifiers to Skill Effect Duration also apply to this Skill's Soul Gain Prevention
